config_profile_name.description: Profile identifier used to derive config filename (e.g., 'conf' → Dianara.conf; 'work' → Dianara_work.conf)

debug.description: Enable detailed debugging output (equivalent to --debug flag)

no_https.description: Disable HTTPS and allow HTTP connections (equivalent to --nohttps)

ignore_ssl_errors.description: Ignore SSL certificate errors (equivalent to --ignoresslerrors); insecure, not recommended

public_default.description: Use 'public' visibility by default for new posts (configures default audience in UI)

server_url.description: Base URL of the Pump.io server (e.g., 'https://pump.example.com')

webfinger_domain.description: Domain part of the user’s WebFinger identifier (e.g., 'example.com' for johndoe@example.com)

username.description: Local part of the user’s WebFinger ID (e.g., 'johndoe' for johndoe@example.com)

access_token.description: OAuth access token or session token for authentication with the server

posts_per_page.description: Number of posts displayed per timeline page

notifications_enabled.description: Enable desktop notifications for new activity

meanwhile_notifications.description: Show notifications for activities in the 'Meanwhile' feed

notification_email.description: Email address to receive notifications (e.g., when posts are commented on)

filter_keywords.description: Comma-separated list of keywords used to filter posts (highlight if matched; ignore otherwise, depending on implementation)
